parts.name: Root
parts.description: The listbox container. It controls the registration of the options, the selection state, the focus, and the keyboard operation.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description:
The behavior of the selection: 'toggle' lets the user remove a selection, and 'replace' always
selects.

props.name: emptyPlaceholder
props.description: The content while the list is empty. It can be a string or a Snippet.

props.name: items
props.description:
The items, for a list that the component makes from an array. Use it with a snippet that
receives one item.

props.name: getItemKey
props.description:
Reads the key of an item. This is the same value as the `id` of `ListBox.Item`.

You need it only with `virtualizer`. Without it, a Shift range is measured over the options in
the DOM. In a virtualized list, those are only the rows near the viewport, thus the range
stops at the scroll position of the user.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: The keys of the items that must be disabled. The user cannot select them.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode: 'single' permits one selection, and 'multiple' permits more than one.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected keys. By default it goes in the two directions: use `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selection at the start, for when you give no `value`.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the selection. The component stops to write back to
`value`, and it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the
parent does not send the new selection down. The default is off, because `bind:value` is the
usual case and it needs the write-back.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the listbox. It can be static children, or a snippet that receives one item.

props.name: header
props.description:
The rows in the listbox above the items, for example an action row such as "Create …". They
are not in `children`, because from an array of items the component calls that snippet one
time for each item.

In a virtualized list, the keyboard does not go into these rows. There, the keys move through
the array of the items, and these rows are not in it.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the listbox container.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the listbox element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the listbox. A screen reader announces it.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description:
The id of an element that the user sees, and that gives the listbox its name. Use it in place
of `aria-label` when the list already has a heading.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the selection changes.

props.name: disableFocusHandling
props.description: Stops the DOM focus control on the root container, for a composition with a virtual focus.

props.name: loop
props.description:
At the last item, the arrow keys move the focus to the first item, and at the first item, to
the last one.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: When the user types a character, the focus moves to the option whose text agrees with it.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Makes only the rows near the viewport, and not all of the rows.

The component obeys it only with `items`. The listbox must control the loop to cut it, thus a
list written as static children is never virtualized.

All of the rows must have the same height. This is what lets the component calculate the
scrollbar without a measurement of each row. The component measures the height from the first
row, but `rowHeight` replaces that measurement. Thus a list with your own styles needs no
fixed number.

The listbox element is the element that scrolls. Give it a maximum height and `overflow-y:
auto`. A long list without a virtualizer needs the same.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the option that the component shows when the list has no items.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the listbox.

dataAttributes.name: data-listbox-spacer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the element that holds the full scroll height while the list is virtualized.

dataAttributes.name: data-listbox-window
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the element that holds the rows that the virtualizer makes.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: An option that the user can select. It registers itself with the root. It shows its selected, focused, hovered, pressed, and disabled states in data attributes.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of this item. The component uses it for the selection.

props.name: textValue
props.description: The text for the typeahead. If you give none, the component reads it from the content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this item. The user cannot select it.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the item element.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the item.

props.name: customId
props.description: Replaces the id that the component makes. Use it when your component needs its own id.

props.name: disableFocusHandling
props.description:
Stops the DOM focus control. With `true`, the component sets no tabindex and it ignores the
focus events.

props.name: isFocusedOverride
props.description: Replaces the focused state. With this prop, the component uses your value and not its own.

props.name: isFocusVisibleOverride
props.description: Replaces the focus-visible state.

props.name: onItemSelect
props.description:
Replaces the selection behavior. With this prop, the component calls it and does not do its
own selection.

props.name: onResolvedTextValue
props.description:
The component calls it with the text value when the item goes into the DOM. That text comes
from the prop or from the content.

props.name: onItemHoverStart
props.description: The component calls it when the pointer must move the logical focus to this item.

props.name: scrollOnFocus
props.description: Scrolls this item into the viewport when it gets the focus. Use it with a virtual focus.

props.name: isParentDisabled
props.description: A second disabled state, from the parent.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Replaces the pressed state. With this prop, the component uses your value and not its own.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is focused.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the item.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id
dataAttributes.description: The item id used for selection.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id-type
dataAttributes.description: The type of the item id: "string" or "number".

dataAttributes.name: data-navigation-item
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the item as a keyboard-navigation target.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is actively pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is selected.
